pull_request.title: docs(lints): add comprehensive rustdoc to soroban_cost_lints core module
pull_request.body:
Closes #193

## Summary

Adds comprehensive rustdoc to `soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs` — the crate's
core module — where every `LateLintPass` and `Visitor` trait implementation
lives. The public API surface and every lint's detection strategy are now
documented directly on the items they describe.

This addresses the gap in #193 where the trait implementations in the
core module lacked comprehensive documentation.

## Coverage

- **Module-level `//!`** — explains the crate's role within the workspace,
  the input-independent detection philosophy (false positives must collapse
  to "almost certainly a bug"), and the cross-crate contract with
  `cargo-cost-lint` (it reads `LINT_METADATA`).
- **`LintCategory` enum** — top-level doc plus per-variant docs (`Cpu`,
  `Memory`, `SymbolOperations`, `Io`, `Storage`, `Other`).
- **`LintMetadata` struct & fields** (`name`, `category`, `description`,
  `version`) plus the `LINT_METADATA` registry const.
- **`register_lints`** entry point — explains how new lints hook into the
  dylint `LintStore`.
- **All six lint pass structs** — `SorobanStorageInLoop`,
  `RedundantEnvClone`, `UnnecessaryHostFunctionCall`, `HostInLoop`,
  `SymbolNewForShortLiteral`, `BytesAppendInLoop` — each pair of `///` docs
  on the struct *and* its `impl LateLintPass` block describes what the
  lint flags, the structural pattern it matches, and how the helpers
  (`enclosing_loop`, `depends_on_loop_state`, `is_valid_short_symbol`,
  the `SOROBAN_*` const arrays) compose into the final decision.

## Decisions taken

- Added `#![allow(rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links)]` at file scope so
  intra-doc links to helper functions, the `SOROBAN_*` const arrays, and
  the trait impls (`enclosing_loop`, `depends_on_loop_state`,
  `is_valid_short_symbol`, `SOROBAN_HOST_TYPES`, etc.) build without
  spurious warnings.
- Plain backticks (not bracket-links) are used for any symbol that lives
  outside this crate's `[dependencies]` (`soroban_sdk::*`, `symbol_short!`
  in user code) to avoid `rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links` warnings.
- Doc phrasing avoids asserting unverified CLI behaviour: categories are
  described as "surfaced by `cargo-cost-lint`" without claims about
  rendering, colours, or imperative tool behaviour.

## Quality gates

The diffusion before this PR is +119 lines, doc-only — no behavioural
code changes, no new public API, no new dependencies.

Required quality gates per `CONTRIBUTING.md`:

    cargo fmt --all -- --check
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
    cargo test --workspace

These could **not** be executed in the sandbox used to author the
change. The pinned `nightly-2026-04-16` toolchain with `rustc-dev` /
`llvm-tools-preview` / `clippy` components is not installed there
(`cargo`/`rustup` not available). They will need to be run on a host
with the pinned toolchain before merge — flagging this explicitly so
it's not a surprise to reviewers.

## Notes for reviewers

- Single-file diff: `soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs` (+119 / -0).
- No public API changes — `cargo doc --no-deps` output will gain ~119
  lines of explanatory text and zero new symbols.
- Existing tests / fixtures / `Cargo.toml` / CI are untouched; the
  branch sits on top of `main` at `9917e9f` (the HEAD before this
  commit) with a single-file diff, so no other files are in conflict.

commits.message:
docs(lints): add comprehensive rustdoc to core module

Adds rustdoc to the entire public surface of soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs,
the crate core module that defines every LateLintPass and Visitor
implementation. Coverage:

- Module-level //! documentation
- LintCategory enum and variants
- LintMetadata struct + fields + the LINT_METADATA registry const
- register_lints entry point
- All six lint pass structs (SorobanStorageInLoop, RedundantEnvClone,
  UnnecessaryHostFunctionCall, HostInLoop, SymbolNewForShortLiteral,
  BytesAppendInLoop) plus their impl LateLintPass blocks
- Allow rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links so intra-doc references to
  helpers and const arrays build without warnings

Refs #193.
